diagnosis.what_happened: Manuscript was generated using generic defaults (B Nazanin 14 pt, 1-inch margins) ignoring the institutional template.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: The generated document failed institutional formatting checks because it didn't align with the required font (B Lotus) and specific metric margins.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: The system should have extracted formatting parameters from 01_raw_inputs/help.pdf or Thesis.docx before generating the output.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Institutional formatting guidelines supercede generic defaults and must be programmatically respected to ensure acceptance.

desired_behavior: Always extract institutional typography profiles (fonts, margins, heading hierarchies) from provided templates (help.pdf, baseline DOCX) prior to document compilation, rather than falling back on generic font/margin assignments.
generalization: Institutional rules strictly override generic academic defaults.
